what: the derived phenotypic correlation against SOLAR's, on real GOBS data
definition: rho_p = rho_g*sqrt(h1*h2) + rho_e*sqrt((1-h1)*(1-h2)); the total variances cancel
note: derived, never estimated -- SOLAR reports it the same way, with no standard error
redaction: Per-trait names and estimates removed before the repository was made public: they are unpublished GOBS results, and this record exists to state agreement with SOLAR, which the retained figures do in full.
